Hi Marissa / Neha,

Thanks for engaging on the RFP. Attached is the Legal Questionnaire and our standard Master Order Form (MOF). Our legal team would like written responses to the questionnaire plus any proposed redlines to the MOF. Key items they flagged: IP ownership for derivative outputs, reciprocal indemnity for security incidents, and liability caps tied to fees or a multiple thereof.

Hi Samantha — thanks for the packet. Please find our initial responses attached (Redwood_RFP_Legal_Answers_v1.docx) and our current Master Order Form (Redwood_Master_Order_Form_v3.pdf) showing our standard commercial positions.

High-level callouts up front:
- IP & outputs: Our standard position is customer owns its input data and customer-facing outputs; Redwood retains model architecture and improvements. We can offer a limited, perpetual, royalty-free license to outputs for internal business purposes.
- Indemnity: We propose mutual indemnities for third-party claims arising from willful misconduct or gross negligence; for security incidents, we provide incident response cooperation and a limited indemnity for breaches caused by Redwood's failure to follow agreed controls.
- Liability cap: Our MOF proposes a cap of $5,000,000 or 3x fees paid in the prior 12 months, whichever is greater. If GlobalBank requires a higher cap, please specify the rationale/thresholds.

We are happy to discuss and will loop legal if you have specific redline requests. DocuSign is acceptable for signature.

Attachments: Redwood_RFP_Legal_Answers_v1.docx, Redwood_Master_Order_Form_v3.pdf

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Neha / Rishi — forwarding Samantha's packet and the answers I drafted. Please review the attached Redwood_RFP_Legal_Answers_v1.docx (key sections flagged inline).

Ask: could Legal weigh in on whether we can accept a higher liability cap for regulated financial customers and whether the proposed IP license language exposes us to downstream claims? My suggested commercial fallback: adjust cap to $10M (or 3x fees) and tighten the indemnity carveouts (exclude model improvements and inference outputs that rely on customer inputs).

Quick notes inline in doc; we need a recommendation before I send a formal redline.

Thanks — Marissa

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-07-12T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: GlobalBank RFP – Legal questionnaire & MOF (attached)

Marissa — I reviewed the highlights. High level: agree that we should avoid an open-ended liability exposure for model behavior. My suggested positions:
- Liability cap: accept up to $15M or 3x fees (whichever is greater) for enterprise financial customers with confirmed SOC2 + contractual security controls.
- Indemnity: maintain narrow indemnity for Redwood-caused data breaches; carve out model outputs and model improvements.
- IP: agree to license outputs for internal use; preserve our rights in improvements and models.

If Legal thinks the $15M cap is ok with additional security attestations, proceed to offer that as a compromise. I'll be available on the call if needed.

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations

From: James Carter <j.carter@externallaw.com>

Subject: Re: GlobalBank RFP – Legal questionnaire & MOF (attached)

Marissa / Team,

On behalf of GlobalBank legal, a few counterpoints to note:
1) Liability cap: Our standard for strategic vendors is either $50M or 4x fees in the prior 12 months, whichever is greater. This is driven by potential systemic risk and regulatory expectations.
2) Indemnity: We require a broad indemnity for claims arising from Vendor's willful misconduct, negligent security failures, and IP infringement claims alleging that the vendor's deliverables infringe third-party rights.
3) IP: For outputs that are derivative of bank data, we expect exclusive ownership of the specific outputs (to the extent they are uniquely generated for GlobalBank) or at minimum exclusive commercial rights.
4) Order form: We accept DocuSign but need the MOF countersigned by an authorized officer and prefer a single-signature flow tied to a PO. I've included a DocuSign link for a redlineable MOF.

Attached: redlined MOF excerpt (see comments on sections 7–9). Happy to set a call if helpful.

Regards,
James Carter
External Counsel to GlobalBank

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@globalbank.com>, James Carter <j.carter@externallaw.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-18T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GlobalBank RFP – Legal questionnaire & MOF (attached)

Samantha / James — thank you for the clarity and the redlines. We've discussed internally with Sales Ops and initial Legal input. Proposed compromise below to keep momentum:

- Liability cap: Redwood can accept a $15,000,000 cap or 3x fees in the prior 12 months, whichever is greater, for enterprise financial customers that (i) complete our security questionnaire and (ii) receive our SOC 2 Type II and a SOC 2 attestation on the production environment. For claims arising from willful misconduct or gross negligence, we acknowledge higher exposure per governing law.
- Indemnity: Redwood will provide indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims that are directly caused by Redwood’s delivered software as-is. For security incidents, Redwood will indemnify for incidents resulting from Redwood’s material failure to comply with agreed security controls; exclusions apply for customer misconfiguration and customer data misuse.
- IP/Outputs: For outputs generated solely from GlobalBank data and marked in the SOW, GlobalBank will receive an exclusive, time-limited commercial license for those outputs for internal use; Redwood retains rights to model improvements and underlying model weights.
- Order form & signature: DocuSign is acceptable. We will prepare the finalized MOF with the agreed cap and indemnity language and send via DocuSign for signature. Please confirm authorized signatory and whether a PO number will be issued at signature.

Attachments: MOF_DocuSign_Link.txt (link to shared envelope), Redwood_RFP_Legal_Answers_v1.docx (updated inline to reflect compromise).

If that is acceptable, we can finalize redlines and prepare the DocuSign envelope by EOD July 22. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to resolve remaining language.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
